This review selects a fixed bounded core: ordinary political peace is not the ontological loss of meaningful difference; mortal theological labels alone do not establish objective divine identities; Calan'thir and Asmodeus genuinely established the public Crucible layer. Current source/owner qualifications remain part of each truth. More specific campaign revelation requires its actual established content and earned ladder/gate; do not invent or silently bypass that gate. Missing dependent content holds that branch.
procedureContent.stun: NEW CR198-DURATION: after delivery, each recipient capable of actually comprehending at least one substantive truth makes the printed WIS save using the actual casting class DC. On failure apply full native Stunned for one round: ends at its first future regular END, excluding the end of a target turn already underway. Outside initiative use6elapsedseconds, preserving that deadline on mode change. No repeat save, concentration, damage-break or extra save is added. Full Stunned means Incapacitated/noAction/BA/Reaction, no movement, automaticSTR/DEXfailure, attacks against have advantage and faltering speech; newly effective incapacitation ends actual concentration immediately.
